plot_training_logs: plot training and test logs for fields like class_error, loss_bbox_unscaled, and mAP from experiment directories
plot_precision_recall_curves: plot precision-recall and scores-recall curves from COCO evaluation torch files for multiple experiments
plot_logs_with_custom_fields: plot training logs with custom fields and exponential weighted moving average smoothing across multiple log files
plot_precision_recall_by_exp_id: plot precision-recall curves using experiment ID naming scheme from a list of torch file paths
summarize_plot_utils: summarize the plot_utils module which provides visualization functions for detection transformer training metrics and COCO evaluation results
